From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in generation latency - initial diagnostics

Marissa / Evan —

Quick diagnostic notes from the on-call infra team:
- We observed increased tokenization time in the preprocessor queue and an elevated tail in GPU scheduling on shard group g3 at 08:48–09:05 PDT.
- No config rollouts or model swaps were triggered from Redwood control plane in that window.
- A transient ETL job in one of our tenant housekeeping tasks caused higher I/O on the storage cluster serving KV caches; that correlates with increased cache misses.

Action taken:
- Throttled the housekeeping job and diverted KV cache load to the warm cache pool at 09:02 PDT.
- Bumped capacity on g3 for the immediate window.

Preliminary impact: latency improved to ~1.2s p95 after mitigation but error rate remains elevated at ~1.4%. We need deeper log correlation on request ids for errors.

Attaching a short warroom brief with timelines (warroom-brief.docx).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
karthik@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: LatticeAI incident update (May 30) — mitigation complete, next steps and post-mortem

Evan / Maya —

Quick customer-facing update following the war-room:

Summary:
- Impact: transient p95 latency spike and elevated error rates observed on 2026-05-29 08:48–09:30 PDT tied to KV cache pressure caused by a tenant housekeeping ETL.
- Mitigation: we diverted KV load to a warm cache pool, throttled the offending ETL job, and applied a short capacity bump to shard group g3. These steps reduced p95 to ~300–500ms and error rate to baseline by 14:00 PDT on 2026-05-30.
- Customer guidance: No action required on your side. If you still observe errors, please send request ids to ops@latticeai.com and we’ll prioritize.

Next steps & commitments:
- Post-mortem: We will deliver a technical post-mortem and action plan by 2026-06-03.
- Preventive changes: schedule to gate tenant ETL jobs during off-peak windows and add a KV cache autoscaling guard.
- Credits: If this incident caused billing-affecting downtime for end-customers, we will evaluate credits on a case-by-case basis; Laura will coordinate.

If you want a short executive readout, we can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow with our CTO and your leadership.

Apologies for the disruption — we appreciate your patience and the logs you provided.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
